intro: Soft, calming, and effortlessly elegant, this chambray blue cushion cover brings a sense of serenity to any space. Designed for modern living, it blends comfort and style beautifully.

features.title: Soft but strong, built to stay
features.text: Woven from soft and durable Chambray cotton, this cushion cover ensures unmatched comfort and resilience for everyday use in your stylish home.

features.title: Simple, stylish, made to match
features.text: Whether layered with patterned cushions or used standalone, its timeless design complements sofas, beds, or chairs with effortless grace.

features.title: Built with care meant to last
features.text: Precision stitching and a flawless finish embody exceptional craftsmanship, ensuring this cushion cover becomes a proud centerpiece of your decor.

care: Dry clean recommended or gentle hand wash with mild detergent and cold water. Wash separately to prevent color bleeding. Do not tumble dry. Do not bleach. Dry inside out in shade. Do not iron.
